lines.en: I beat the wood with a stick.
Thud, thud, thud; three neat knocks.

lines.zh: 节奏就是我走路的方式。
lines.en: Rhythm is how I walk.
Sixteen oak logs are stacked here.

lines.zh: 六十四根木棍在我手里。
lines.en: Sixty-four sticks in my hands.
Wherever I go, I keep knocking.
The wood here is not sound.
It splits the moment I strike.
The whole alley holds this sound.
Nobody can sleep.
I cannot be bothered with that.
The sky is dark; still early.
I knock along the base of the wall.
A layer of dust falls off the wall.
The drumming stopped. So did I.
There is not a sound.
That will not do at all.
I knock three times more.
That is much better.
This is what I was given.
Wood, and sticks.
I am pleased with this.
The chips on the ground grow deeper.
I sit on the pile of chips.
The wood is stacked neatly.
I stacked it stick by stick.
Chips cling to my hands.

lines.zh: 我杵着木棍，嘴里念念有词。
lines.en: Leaning on my stick, I mutter over and over.
Are you counting my knocks?
You cannot possibly count them.

lines.zh: 离我一根木棍的距离，站好。
lines.en: Stand one stick-length away from me.
The stick sometimes misses.
You take my meaning.
You backed off half a pace.
This is good enough.

lines.zh: 木头敲地的节奏，你听出来了吗？
lines.en: Did you catch the rhythm of my stick on the ground?
I nearly missed them.
You have no wood on you.
Then you are no guest.
You are covering your ears.
You hear it even covering your ears.
You have stood behind me a long while.
I stop for a moment.
Then I keep knocking.
My hand is numb.
The stick is still there.
This is nothing.
Would you like to hear it too?
I switch hands.
The other hand can still knock.
The stick in my hand is shorter now.
I take a new one.
That piece of wood in your hand.
This piece looks good.
Pass it here quickly.
I want to knock with it.
Not for eating; for knocking.
Will you give it or not?
Why hold the wood up high?
I can see it.
Knocking is what I want.
Give me one of the sticks.
You hit my stick.
It nearly slipped my grip.
I gripped it tight.
Move aside.
I have knocking to do.
You knocked my wood out of line.
I set it back piece by piece.
Stop moving about.
I cannot get past you.
The alley is only this wide.
This sort of thing I do not understand.
I have only the one stick.
And this wood.
This is enough for me.
There is only wood here.
Go ask someone else.
I still have wood to knock.
And this shape of mine does not suit it.
Do not ask any more.
Knocking wood alone suits me fine.
A broken stick lies on the ground.
The length suits the hand.
I pick it up and test it.
The sound is wrong.
This one is not thick enough.
So I tossed it away.
Listen to the sound before anything.
Anything too brittle is no good.
I keep the good ones.
A few more lie on the ground.
You are standing in front of the wood.
Move.
I cannot reach it now.
I have raised the stick.
This time it is not the wood.
Your hand is coming this way.
I bring the stick across.
You had better pull it back.
I set the wood down.
Now my hands are free.
You picked a bad moment.

lines.zh: 我一边敲一边数，别打断。
lines.en: I knock and count; do not interrupt.

lines.zh: 我拖着木棍，沿着你踩出的路。
lines.en: Dragging my stick, I follow the path you made.
One knock per step.
Thud, thud, once more.
You will turn when you hear it.
That is what I want.
Chips lie at my feet.
I walk over them.
You will hear me first.
Of that I am quite sure.
My stick drags on the ground.
The sound follows along.
No matter how far you run.
I swing the stick at your shoulder.
The stick breaks.
Half of it is still in my hand.
Then again.
I raise another stick.
This one is new.
Your shoulder will remember.
That one landed on the shoulder.
Broken wood flies across the ground.
I pick up another.
Three knocks sound in the alley first.
Only then do I come around the corner.
My hands are full of sticks.

lines.zh: 地上的木头是我带来的。
lines.en: The wood on the ground came with me.
From today I knock on all of this.

lines.zh: 我手里的棍子有六十四根。
lines.en: I have sixty-four sticks in my hands.
I swap them one by one.
The wood will be gone by dawn.
But that is a way off yet.
All the lamps in the alley have gone out.
I can still see.
There is nobody else at the other end.

lines.zh: 木头烧起来，那声音变了。
lines.en: The wood catches and the sound changes.
I fall into the pile of chips.
Water fills my mouth and I keep knocking.
The blast lifts every chip into the air.
An arrow sticks in my wood.
That light stops my hand.

lines.zh: 我不用吃，只是手上没劲。
lines.en: I do not need food; my hands are just weak.

lines.zh: 雷打在棍子上，我跳了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits the stick and I jump.

lines.zh: 脚下的地没了，棍子也掉了。
lines.en: The ground is gone and the stick falls.
